findings.title: Unclear scope for site installation
findings.message: The short text "Baustelleneinrichtung herstellen" and empty long text do not specify the concrete measures, materials or quantities required, violating VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 which demands a clear and exhaustive description.
findings.suggestion: Define the exact items (e.g., temporary offices, fencing, lighting) with quantities and material specifications.

findings.title: Non‑technical text in description
findings.message: The long text contains banking details instead of technical specifications for the protective fence, making the requirement non‑determinable and likely invalid under VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1.
findings.suggestion: Replace banking data with fence material, mesh size, anchoring method and installation instructions.

findings.title: Missing technical data for geotextile
findings.message: Only width (b = 12 m) is given; the type, class, permeability and reference standard (e.g., DIN 18130) are missing, which are required by STLB‑Bau standard texts.
findings.suggestion: Add geotextile class (e.g., non‑woven, CPE‑type), permeability value and compliance standard.

findings.title: Unclear reference to field width
findings.message: The phrase "Baufeldbreite bis 14 m" does not define the actual width for the work, leading to ambiguous quantity calculations.
findings.suggestion: Specify the exact width to be used for volume calculation or provide a range with a clear calculation method.

findings.title: Incomplete sentence and missing dimensions
findings.message: The short text ends abruptly "(Baufeldbreite 12 m" and the long text "bis 14 m" is incomplete, making the scope undefined.
findings.suggestion: Complete the sentence and state the exact area to be prepared, including width and length.

findings.title: Trailing comma and missing material description
findings.message: The short text ends with a comma and the long text only lists "[PERSON_033] Sand" without specifying the required soil type, grading or compaction class.
findings.suggestion: Specify soil class, required compaction, and remove dangling punctuation.

findings.title: Missing description of hand‑digging method
findings.message: Only quantity and unit price are given; no description of depth, equipment or safety measures, which may lead to disputes.
findings.suggestion: Add depth, required tools and safety provisions.

findings.title: Elliptical wording "wie vor, jedoch" without clear definition
findings.message: The phrase "wie vor, jedoch [PERSON_093] DK0 (einschließlich" is incomplete and does not define the scope of the transport service.
findings.suggestion: Provide a full description of the transport service, load limits, distance and any special handling.

findings.title: Missing technical specifications for pump sump
findings.message: No dimensions, material, capacity or reference standard (e.g., DIN 1988) are provided, which are required for hydraulic installations.
findings.suggestion: Add diameter, depth, material class and compliance standard.

findings.title: Unclear frost protection layer specification
findings.message: Only thickness (t=0,30 m) is given; the material, insulation class and installation method are missing.
findings.suggestion: Specify material (e.g., granular fill, geotextile), thermal conductivity and compaction requirements.

findings.title: Missing test procedure details
findings.message: The phrase "Innendruckprüfung GGG DN 300 und DN 250" lacks pressure level, duration, acceptance criteria and reference standard (e.g., VDI 2035).
findings.suggestion: Define test pressure, hold time, required documentation and acceptance limits.

findings.title: Missing pipe class and material grade
findings.message: Only diameter and designation (TYT DN 300 (C50)) are given; the required material standard (e.g., DIN EN 805) and pressure class are not specified.
findings.suggestion: Add material grade, pressure class and compliance standard.

findings.title: Missing pipe diameter and class for PE‑HD
findings.message: The entry only states "PE‑HD Rohre 2 x" without specifying nominal diameter, pressure class (PN) or standard (e.g., DIN EN 12201).
findings.suggestion: Add nominal diameter, PN value and reference standard.

findings.title: Empty description
findings.message: Both short and long texts are missing, providing no information about the required work, which is a clear breach of VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1.
findings.suggestion: Insert a complete description of the item, including quantity, material and execution details.

findings.title: Empty description for PE‑HD pipe length
findings.message: No description is provided for the 2380 m of work, violating the requirement for a clear specification.
findings.suggestion: Specify installation method, bedding, jointing system and required standards.

findings.title: Empty description for PE‑HD pipe length
findings.message: Missing technical description for the 420 m of work, leading to ambiguity.
findings.suggestion: Provide full execution details as for 4.1.60.

findings.title: Penalty clause for delayed hydraulic excavator use
findings.message: The note imposes a €5,000 per day penalty for late deployment of a hydraulic excavator, which may be an unlawful penalty clause and a risk transfer prohibited by § 307 BGB.
findings.suggestion: Replace the penalty with a reasonable liquidated damages clause that reflects actual damage.

findings.title: Inconsistent unit for position 2.1.210
findings.message: Lehmschürzen are quantified in "St" (pieces) but the work likely requires linear meters; mismatch may cause calculation errors.
findings.suggestion: Confirm whether the unit should be "m" or "St" and adjust accordingly.

findings.title: Contradictory wording in multiple "wie vor, jedoch" positions
findings.message: Positions 2.1.70, 2.1.260, 2.1.370, 2.1.410, 2.1.480, 2.3.40, 2.5.20, 2.5.30, 3.1.20, 3.1.60, 3.2.20, 4.1.140, 4.1.160, 4.1.200 use "wie vor, jedoch" without a preceding reference, creating ambiguity about the base scope.
findings.suggestion: Add a clear reference to the base position or rewrite the clause to be self‑contained.
